description: This file defines a final PHP class 'Serializer' that extends 'AbstractSerializer' and provides static methods for serializing and deserializing PSR-7 Response objects to and from strings and streams, including parsing HTTP status lines and headers.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A final class for serializing and deserializing HTTP responses, providing static methods to parse response strings/streams into Response objects and vice versa.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Deserializes a response string into a Response object by creating a stream and parsing it.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Reads a Response object from a stream, validating readability and seekability, then parsing status line, headers, and body.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes a Response object into a string formatted as an HTTP response message.

methods.name: getStatusLine
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP version, status code, and reason phrase from a stream by reading the status line and parsing it with a regex.
